from pathlib import Path
import re
paths = ['README.md', 'docs/source/installation.md', 'docs/source/development.md', 'examples/cli_tutorial.md']
for filename in paths:
    path = Path(filename)
    for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', path.read_text()):
        if '://' in target:
            continue
        name, _, anchor = target.partition('#')
        linked = path.parent / name if name else path
        assert linked.exists(), (filename, target)
        if anchor:
            headings = re.findall(r'^#+ (.+)$', linked.read_text(), re.M)
            anchors = [re.sub(r'[^\w -]', '', h.lower()).replace(' ', '-') for h in headings]
            assert anchor in anchors, (filename, target)
print('Markdown links and section anchors passed.')
